text: 反驳不了捏。
en: You really can't refute that.

text: 因为咱妈不能干涉他国的选择。
en: Because our motherland cannot interfere in other countries' choices.

text: 新加坡就有芽笼，持证上岗合理合法。
en: Singapore has Geylang, and working there with a licence is entirely lawful and legitimate.

text: 咱妈周围这一圈地方，这样的数不胜数呢。
en: All around our motherland there are countless such places.

text: 也就这比较特色了。
en: That is just what makes it rather distinctive.

text: 吃喝嫖钱是花不完的，房婚孩再努力钱也是不够用的。
en: Money spent on dining, drinking and prostitution is never used up, yet however hard you strive, money is still never enough for a home, marriage and children.

text: 三国杀中，步练师体验只需五百，永久拥有则需十万，而国际服却是免费。
en: In Sanguosha, trying out Lianshi Bu costs only five hundred, while permanent ownership costs one hundred thousand, yet the international server is free.

text: 脑子正常的人，都会用脚做出选择。
en: Any sane person would vote with their feet.

text: 你不支持女性的性自由？
en: You don't support women's sexual freedom?

text: 你不知道女权主义者里专门有一派支持合法吗？
en: Didn't you know there is a whole strand of feminism that supports legalisation?

text: 这种问题为什么要都怪男人？
en: Why should men take the blame for this kind of problem?

text: 女人才是自己身体的主人。
en: Women are the masters of their own bodies.

text: 曾经看到个说法。
en: I once came across a saying.

text: 10个小姐姐就能摧毁一个县城的房地产。
en: Ten young ladies could ruin the property market of a county town.

text: 仔细想想为什么？
en: Think carefully about why?

text: 尤其是面对全球数一数二的性价格更该想想为什么？
en: Especially given that sex here is among the cheapest in the world, you ought to wonder why.

text: 别扯什么剥夺妇女权益，好多小姐姐想赚这个钱苦无没有门路。
en: Stop going on about depriving women of their rights — plenty of these girls want to earn this money but simply have no channel to do so.

text: 持证上岗，每年体检，合法纳税。
en: Work with a licence, get a health check every year, and pay tax lawfully.

text: 但是绝对不行，至于为什么，我也不知道。
en: But it is absolutely not allowed, and as for why, I don't know either.

text: 我支持禁止一切金钱交易的卖淫行为，但法律不支持我
en: I support banning all prostitution involving money, but the law does not support me.

text: 当有钱人花钱养几个女人当玩物都完全合法，你要怎么去说服那些没有性竞争力的底层群众接受自己不能以相对低价换取自己缺乏的性资源？
en: When the wealthy can spend money keeping several women as playthings entirely legally, how do you persuade those lower-class people with no sexual competitiveness to accept that they cannot exchange relatively cheap money for the sexual resources they lack?

text: 卖淫非法。
en: Prostitution is illegal.

text: 但包养合法，约P合法，谈恋爱合法。
en: But being kept is legal, hooking up is legal, and dating is legal.

text: 那花1000包养一天合法吗？
en: So is it legal to pay a thousand to keep a woman for a day?

text: 约P完给她1000误工费合法吗？
en: Is it legal to hand over a thousand in compensation after a hookup?

text: 谈一天恋爱送个1000的礼物合法吗？
en: Is it legal to give a thousand-yuan gift over a day of dating?

text: 我反对卖淫合法化
en: I oppose the legalisation of prostitution.

text: 但问题是凭什么单次结算的嫖娼又要违法处罚又受社会道德遣责，而又老又丑又胖的权贵富豪们公开长期包养多名女性就不违法还能被夸有本事？
en: But the question is, why is a one-off paid sexual encounter both punished as illegal and condemned by social morality, while old, ugly, fat plutocrats who openly keep multiple women long-term break no law and even get praised for their prowess?

text: 合着穷人钱少就是强制剥削压迫女性，富人钱多就是自由恋爱尊重女性？
en: So when the poor pay little it is forced exploitation and oppression of women, but when the rich pay a lot it is free love and respect for women?

text: 反驳不了，只能诉诸虚伪的道德。
en: Can't be refuted — one can only resort to hypocritical morality.

text: 成年人有权利使用自己的身体提供性服务换取报酬。
en: Adults have the right to use their own bodies to provide sexual services in exchange for payment.

text: 卖力气、卖血、卖头发、卖笑、卖唱、卖艺又比卖肉高尚多少呢？
en: How much nobler is selling one's strength, blood, hair, smile, singing or talent than selling one's body?

text: 五十步笑百步。
en: Fifty paces mocking a hundred.

text: 卖淫非法只有短短几十年历史，而中国人习惯以千年的尺度去审视历史。
en: The illegality of prostitution has only a short history of a few decades, yet Chinese people are used to examining history on a millennial scale.

text: 年卡合法禁止单抽我不认为这有什么公平可言。
en: That annual passes are legal while single draws are forbidden — I see no fairness in that.

text: 有本事先把充值入口锁了吧
en: If you've got what it takes, lock the top-up gateway first.

text: 不用反驳
en: No need to refute.

text: 包月包年合法
en: Monthly and annual packages are legal.

text: double standards
en: double standards

text: 存天理灭人欲的清教徒观点是过去的糟粕，迟早要死的。
en: The Puritan view of preserving heavenly principle and extinguishing human desire is the dross of the past; it will die sooner or later.

text: 包养情人是合法的，嫖娼是非法的。
en: Keeping a mistress is legal; visiting prostitutes is illegal.

text: 就是说，批发（一段时间）是合法的，而零售（过夜）是非法的。
en: That is to say, wholesale (over a period) is legal, while retail (overnight) is illegal.

text: 这个确实很难论证。
en: This one really is hard to argue.

text: 你唯一能反驳的机会就是赌对方没看过国内对于灰色产业的相关调查文学然后抓住自愿卖淫这一点输出，把卖淫行为打成社会压迫。
en: Your only chance to refute is to bet that the other side hasn't read the domestic investigative writing on the grey industry, then seize on the point of voluntary prostitution and argue that prostitution is social oppression.

text: 因为这方面的调查文学特别是在老广的基本都表示很多小姐真就是自愿卖淫甚至因为可以变相控制男性而产生女权自豪感的，事实上卖淫合法化恰恰是现代资本主义女权的一大议题之一，包括国内也是有不少文章在旁敲侧击地将诸如劳动义务以及卖淫非法这类传统女权观念评为社会和集体的思想影响而并非所谓女性的自我意志，娼妓崇拜是这一思想当中相当源远流长的观念，所谓良家不如妓女自由。
en: Because the investigative writing on this subject, especially in Guangdong, basically all shows that many of these women are genuinely voluntary prostitutes, even developing a feminist pride from being able to control men indirectly; in fact, the legalisation of prostitution is precisely one of the major issues of modern capitalist feminism. Even domestically there are quite a few articles that obliquely judge traditional feminist notions such as the duty to labour and the illegality of prostitution as the influence of society and the collective, rather than any so-called women's own will. The worship of prostitutes is a rather long-standing idea within this thinking — the so-called 'decent women are less free than prostitutes'.

text: 我甚至觉得您这位亲属可能还是有点礼貌，毕竟在你直接开骂的情况下对方是yygq而不是直接问候一下你在未婚期间是不是处女。
en: I would even say your relative was perhaps being somewhat polite; after all, given that you started swearing at them, they were merely being passive-aggressive rather than flat-out asking whether you had been a virgin before marriage.

text: 嫖这个事违法就很难说通。
en: That whoring is illegal is hard to justify.

text: 黄赌毒都是公认的错误。
en: Vice, gambling and drugs are all universally recognised as wrong.

text: 赌和毒，你越是深入接触，判罚标准越重。
en: With gambling and drugs, the deeper you get involved, the heavier the penalty.

text: 但是到黄上，则反过来了，你偶尔去，是违法行为，你长期搞黄，是道德问题。
en: But with vice it is the reverse: the occasional visit is an illegal act, while engaging in it long-term is a moral issue.

text: 没钱的普通人偶尔去，是违法，有钱人长期搞，是道德不好，不违法。
en: Ordinary people without money who go occasionally are breaking the law; the wealthy who do it long-term merely have poor morals and break no law.

text: 所以，这个到底是不是事专门针对普通人的违法行为呢，是不是和封建社会一样，刑不上大夫呢。
en: So is this not simply an illegal act targeted at ordinary people, just like in feudal society where punishment never reached the high officials?

text: 看过一个律师的采访，他代理也研究过很多卖淫嫖娼类的案件，他说了一些普通人很难理解的基本事实。
en: I saw an interview with a lawyer who has represented clients in and researched many prostitution and soliciting cases; he stated some basic facts that ordinary people find hard to understand.

text: 1、从事卖淫的女性没有被迫的，都是自己自愿的。
en: 1. Women engaged in prostitution are none of them forced; all are there voluntarily.

text: 2、卖淫女几乎没有特别“穷”的，一般最便宜的一次，哪怕四五十岁那种大龄从业人员，一次也要100块，甚至更多，一天可以赚几百，甚至几千。
en: 2. Prostitutes are hardly ever particularly 'poor'. Generally even the cheapest session — even for older workers in their forties or fifties — costs at least a hundred yuan, often more; a day can earn several hundred, even several thousand.

text: 一个月都可以赚几万，甚至几十万。
en: In a month they can earn tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands.

text: 妥妥的“高薪”职业！
en: A thoroughly 'high-paying' profession!

text: 这些都是有法院案卷真实可查的。
en: All of this can be verified from real court records.

text: 3、卖淫只是违法，但不是犯罪！
en: 3. Prostitution is only illegal, not a crime!

text: 这一点至关重要，只会被治安处罚，行政拘留。
en: This point is crucial: one only faces public-security penalties and administrative detention.

text: 但是容留，组织卖淫，是犯罪，是要判刑的。
en: But harbouring or organising prostitution is a crime, punishable by a prison sentence.

text: 所以卖淫女对组织者并不弱势，卖淫女并不会被“欺负”，因为组织容留卖淫更怕被查！
en: So prostitutes are not the weaker party against their organisers, and prostitutes are not 'bullied', because those who organise and harbour prostitution fear investigation even more!

text: 4、很多人担心卖淫合法会有人口买卖。
en: 4. Many worry that legal prostitution would bring human trafficking.

text: 甚至会有人专门养女童，然后长大后让她们卖淫获利。
en: Some might even specifically raise girls, then when they grow up force them into prostitution for profit.

text: 人口买卖这种事就不反驳了。
en: As for human trafficking, I won't dispute that point.

text: 有个东西叫“保险”，很多人会投保给孩子，配偶，然后故意制造意外弄死弄残，但是没有人说是保险这种制度的错误。
en: There is a thing called 'insurance': many take out policies on their children or spouses, then deliberately cause accidents to kill or maim them, yet no one blames the institution of insurance itself.

text: 5、正是因为卖淫现实里不合法，所以才会“更贵”，他有一部份是风险议价。
en: 5. Precisely because prostitution is in reality illegal, it is 'pricier' — part of that is a risk premium.

text: 卖淫嫖娼不会因为不合法少哪怕一丁点！
en: Prostitution and soliciting will not decrease one bit because they are illegal!

text: 就像国内其他色情产业也不合法，但是依旧有大量直播，甚至是付费直播存在，唯一的坏处，就是价格更高了。
en: Just as other pornographic industries domestically are also illegal, yet there are still vast numbers of livestreams, even paid ones; the only downside is that prices are higher.

text: 6、天底下杀头的买卖有人干，但是赔本的买卖，没人干，杜绝卖淫嫖娼唯一的途径，就是让它变成“赔本”的买卖。
en: 6. In this world, people will do businesses that risk beheading, but no one does a loss-making business; the only way to eliminate prostitution and soliciting is to make it a 'loss-making' business.

text: 你控制不了女性，她只是轮到你了，并不是属于你，抱着这样的想法将来生活中才不会钻牛角尖
en: You cannot control a woman; she is only with you in turn, not yours. Holding this mindset, you won't tie yourself in knots in future life.

text: 我国现在无论道德、还是法律，都是拿来主义，东拼西凑，什么好用就拼进去，最后整个四不像。
en: Our country now, whether in morality or law, practises sheer eclecticism — patching things together, throwing in whatever works, and ending up a total hotchpotch.

text: 比如卖淫认为违法，但包养不违法，说一对多是错误的，收钱不重要。
en: For instance, prostitution is deemed illegal, but being kept is not; having multiple partners is called wrong, yet the money taken does not matter.

text: 再换成约炮，一对多又不违法了，甚至也不违反道德。
en: Switch to casual hookups, and having multiple partners is suddenly not illegal, not even immoral.

text: 因为没收钱，跟多少男人上，是女性自由。
en: Because no money changes hands, sleeping with however many men is a woman's freedom.

text: 最后再换成结婚，收钱又变成正确的，既不违法也不违反道德。
en: Finally switch to marriage, and taking money becomes proper again — neither illegal nor immoral.

text: 总结一下：在我国，一对一、一对多、收钱，其实都并非是违法、或违反道德的必要组成要件。
en: To sum up: in our country, one-on-one, one-to-many, and taking money are in fact not necessary constituent elements of illegality or immorality.

text: 但又机械古板的把卖淫视作了违法行为。
en: Yet it mechanically and rigidly treats prostitution as an illegal act.
